messages:
Sasha M: Hey finance team — I booked travel for the EU trip and the vendor charged one combined invoice that includes 1 personal night + 4 work nights. Total = $1,342.50. How should I submit so the company covers only the business portion?
Expense Bot: Please attach the itemized invoice or booking confirmation PDF. If the vendor groups charges, we need manager approval and a line-item breakdown. See policy: https://redwood.example/policies/expenses
Sasha M: Link to vendor invoice (PDF): https://travelvendor.example/invoices/INV-98765.pdf — thanks. The PDF has dates but shows one total, no per-night lines. I grabbed a screenshot of the booking page showing dates: https://imgur.com/example-screenshot
Lexi (Finance): Hi Sasha — ok first step: get a manager sign-off that explicitly states which nights were business vs personal and the amounts to split. Then upload the invoice + sign-off to Expensify (or the self-serve portal).
Sasha M: @Omar R can you confirm the nights? business nights are 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-13, personal night 2026-03-09.
Omar R: Confirmed — I approve business nights 3/10-3/13. I do NOT approve 3/9. Approving the split so finance can reimburse the business portion. :white_check_mark:
Jessie L: Quick Q — do we do per-diem here or actual receipts for meals? Sasha said meals were on personal card for the personal night only.
Lexi (Finance): Meals: for this trip we reimburse actuals with receipts. Per diem only applies for domestic overnight travel under the new policy. For the hotel itself we reimburse the itemized room nights. If vendor can't provide per-night amounts, we ask them to reissue itemized invoice or provide reservation confirmation showing nightly rate.
Sasha M: I asked vendor to reissue but they say it's an agency booking and they only provide total. They sent booking confirmation with nightly rates in the portal (screenshot above) but PDF invoice is a single charge.
Lexi (Finance): OK — here's how we'll handle it: 1) Use the portal nightly breakdown screenshot + manager approval to split. 2) Submit expense with these fields (example):
```
Expense type: Hotel
Total charged: $1,342.50
Business portion: $1,067.00 (4 nights)
Personal portion: $275.50 (1 night)
Exchange rate (if applicable): N/A
Attachments: portal-screenshot.jpg, INV-98765.pdf, manager-signoff.pdf
```
Sasha M: Got it — does the personal portion get billed back to me or deducted from reimbursement?
Lexi (Finance): We'll process reimbursement for the business portion only. The final reimbursed amount = business portion less any corporate card payments already applied. If you already paid the entire invoice on your personal card, you'll receive reimbursement for the business amount. If the corporate card paid part, we will chargeback the personal portion to you (we'll record on payroll as a deduction only if you request).
Jessie L: VAT reclaim question — vendor is EU. If the invoice lacks VAT breakdown, we can't reclaim VAT. Vendor portal has VAT numbers on the booking confirmation screenshot?
Sasha M: The portal screenshot shows VAT=not shown. PDF shows "taxes" line but no VAT reg no.
Lexi (Finance): If there's no VAT ID and no VAT line, mark expense as non-reclaimable. Finance will code it `TRAVEL-NONRECLAIM`. If vendor can provide VAT ID and VAT amount, we can submit for reclaim.
Sasha M: Uploaded to Expensify: https://expensify.com/receipts/abc123, added manager signoff and screenshot.
Lexi (Finance): Received. Two small remaining items: (1) Please add the split amounts as separate line items in Expensify so our AP system can post the corporate charge and personal charge separately; (2) Because business portion > $1,000, we need Avery (CFO) sign-off before payment. Looping them in. @Avery (CFO) — can you sign off on $1,067 business hotel reimbursement?
Avery (CFO): Reviewed. I approve the $1,067 business portion based on manager sign-off and portal screenshot. Approve to proceed with reimbursement.
Lexi (Finance): Thanks @Avery. Processing now — target payment date next payroll (two business days). Sasha, you'll get a confirmation email when processed. :email:
Sasha M: Thanks all! Appreciate the quick help. Will keep vendor follow-up notes in the expense thread if they reissue itemized invoice.
Expense Bot: Expense processed in system (ref EXP-2026-00456).
